title: Public Open a ticket page
summary: A new public Open a ticket page shows which APES services take tickets and their areas. Signing in or registering brings visitors back to the right form with the area already chosen.
changes: Add an Open a ticket page that anyone can open, listing APES CIC, APES Shelter and Rescue and APES Pet Care Clinic with their service areas.
Opening a ticket asks signed-out visitors to sign in or register, then returns them to that service's ticket form with the area selected.
Add Open a ticket to the public menu and the home page.
version_rationale: Patch: adds a public listing page and a redirect step to existing ticket forms, with no data change.
validation: New feature test for the public page, sign-in and registration return, prefilled area and refused services.
Ticket, navigation, public page, layout and translation tests.
known_limitations: Anonymous tickets are not supported. People who have not chosen a service in their profile are asked to choose it before the form opens.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.47.4 Beta, issue #466 under epic #463, pull request #596.
